line: Black ink in five tones on warm rice paper, one vermilion seal, most of the frame left empty.
line_cn: 五色墨在宣纸上生长，唯一的朱红是印章，画面大半留白。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: Ink only, from pale cool grey to warm full black, on warm fibrous paper that stays visible everywhere.
Forms are loaded brushstrokes whose dark edge is the contour; wet washes bleed, dry strokes leave flying white.
Sixty to eighty percent of every frame is empty paper: water, sky, mist, silence.
Things are painted into existence rather than cut to; motion is slow, weighted and unhurried.
One vermilion accent, used like a seal: at most one small object or mark per film.
not: Not watercolour: no colour washes, no hue beyond ink and the single vermilion.
Not vector art with a brush texture: no flat fills, no closed outlines.
Not a calligraphy title sequence: characters stay on the paper, type never carries the story.

references.learn: the far-to-near value order and how emptiness reads as water or air
how a figure moves while staying a brushstroke

materials: Rice paper ground: warm, fibrous, slightly uneven; it is the white and never pure white.
Loaded strokes: a dark wet edge, a lighter body, paper showing through at speed.
Wet-into-wet washes for mist and water; dry brush for rock, bark and hair.
No photoreal detail: a face is three strokes, a tree is a trunk and five clumps.

rules: Five ink tones carry everything: far is pale and soft, near is dark and textured.
One vermilion (seal red) for one recurring object or mark; never a red wash, never red light.
When a frame gets busy, remove ink rather than add tone.
colour.examplePalette: paper #efe6d3, pale ink #b8b2a6, mid ink #6f6a62, full ink #221f1c, vermilion #b02e22

type.titleFont: a brush-written display face or Noto Serif SC heavy
type.subtitleFont: Noto Serif SC regular, warm near-black
type.placement: lower third on bare paper, no box; a vertical colophon column is allowed top-right for titles
rules: Subtitles sit on paper, never over ink masses.
Numbers as digits on screen, spelled out in narration.
Slow, weighted moves; a stroke lands and settles, nothing bounces.
Mist and water drift continuously; figures move in a few deliberate strokes.
Transitions grow inside the frame (an ink bloom, mist) instead of cutting.

grammar.expresses: the page is the stage; things are painted in
time and distance as one painting

grammar.note: lateral, lead room, slow far parallax
into an ink bloom or mist
until the mark joins the whole
grammar.expresses: the part was inside something larger

framing: A tiny figure in a wide field of paper reads as solitude; keep the subject at least a third of frame height for emotion beats.
Dark foreground masses may pass along the frame bottom; never crowd the top.

instruments: a small gong for a seal
foley: ink drop (a short tink and a wet thud)
sound.ambience: near-silent room, distant water or wind, no city
sound.silence: literal: the whole bed out, one sound at most inside it, placed where the story holds its breath
sound.voice: calm, few lines, like colophons that do not explain the picture

nativeMoves.name: One stroke is everything
nativeMoves.what: A single stroke becomes the subject.
nativeMoves.build: keyframe mode from a hero frame of blank paper; beats: 'one dark stroke is drawn, it becomes…'; camera static.
fits: a product born from one line
a city from a single street

nativeMoves.name: Ink bloom transition
nativeMoves.what: The next scene grows inside a spreading drop.
nativeMoves.build: bridge link: anchor last frame → end frame of the new scene; beats describe the drop spreading and the scene appearing inside it.
fits: one era giving way to the next

nativeMoves.name: The handscroll
nativeMoves.what: One long painting panned right to left, seen whole at last.
nativeMoves.build: continuous chain of 10–15 s shots, camera pan slow, then a pull_out shot.
fits: a supply chain from field to hand

nativeMoves.name: Emptiness is matter
nativeMoves.what: Removing ink reveals what was there.
nativeMoves.build: jump_cut from the anchor with beats 'the mist thins and reveals…'.
fits: a door opening in a wall

nativeMoves.name: Flying white
nativeMoves.what: One fast dry stroke across the frame, strongest out of a silence.
nativeMoves.build: a 5 s montage shot, pace frantic, camera static, preceded by a still shot with no music.

pitfalls.problem: The model adds colour to skies and water.
pitfalls.fix: Keep 'ink only' in every beat suffix and 'no colour except one vermilion' in negatives.

pitfalls.problem: Faces turn photoreal and lose the brush.
pitfalls.fix: Size cu at most, never ecu on a face; describe faces as 'a few strokes'.
Say 'most of the frame is bare paper' in the beat; prefer els/ls sizes.
camera.move static on every held page; H3 is told to lock off.

look.genre: Chinese ink-wash animation, sumi-e, contemplative wuxia poem
look.palette: black ink in five tones on warm rice paper, one vermilion seal red, no other colour
look.camera: painted handscroll, slow pans and tilts, locked pages
look.lighting: no cast light; value carries depth, pale far and dark near

negative: faces are a few brush strokes: a dot or a dash for each feature
forms are wash and broken brush strokes with soft, open edges
engine.beatSuffix: Everything is brushed ink on rice paper; most of the frame stays empty paper.

structures: a journal kept over one year, one page per season painted over the last
anatomy of one object, each part a stroke close-up
a pursuit across one long scroll that ends where it began
openings: a finished painting we then watch undone to its first stroke
a close-up of wet ink spreading, pulled back to show what it became
a single seal stamped on blank paper
endings: the page left unfinished, brush lifted
a pull back until the figure is a dot in mist
the seal stamped a second time, now with meaning
